objective: Prevent an Android prototype VPN without a forwarding core from being selectable as Always-on VPN, without modifying any owner network/device.

factualProblem.finding: A nonfunctional VpnService was registered in AndroidManifest. Setting SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON=false alone cannot prevent Always-on selection on supported Android API26, since the official flag is effective only API27+. Therefore remove the incomplete service registration until a packet-forwarding core exists.
factualProblem.scope: Risk of user selecting a nonfunctional VPN; actual Always-on enrollment or traffic failure on a physical device was NOT observed.

mutation.mainObjective: Do not expose incomplete VPN service as a system-selectable provider on any supported Android API.
mutation.ciGuard: Parse manifest to assert the unlinked service is absent. Assert core remains unlinked and Activity does not request VpnService.prepare.
mutation.outOfScope: Actual mobile packet forwarding is not implemented; no Android install, user VPN consent, routes, or desktop published assets modified.

verificationVsValidation: Source/manifest guard + hosted Android emulator will verify intent; no Android real-VPN operation or Always-on behavior is declared validated. Owner gateway Status only verifies disconnected status—not PC_TUNNEL success.

rootCausePrevention.rootCause: Registered an incomplete VpnService in package manifest before forwarding core existed; API26 cannot use SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON metadata opt-out.
rootCausePrevention.prevention: Do not register any Android VpnService until forwarding is implemented, license-reviewed and tested; register it only as part of later real VPN-core change set.
rootCausePrevention.guard: Hosted build tests assert no service registration while providerCoreReady=false; emulator verifies lack of permission UI, TUN and interface changes.
rootCausePrevention.regression: Rebuild nested and root integrity manifests, R53 identity and Linux installation guards, full hosted CI

methodDecision.choice: Remove Android system service registration for a core-unlinked placeholder
methodDecision.why: Single manifest omission is effective on all supported API26+; simpler and more complete than a flag only honored on API27+.
rejected: Flag-only SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON=false because Android API26 ignores it
Raise minSdk to 27 solely to mask incomplete service
Add a fake TUN or permission dialog without forwarding
